The 100% precision number is honest but limited — measures 'file content actually changed' (trivially correct by SHA256) not 'change violates linked req intent' (req-relevance precision unmeasured). Predicted-band 50-70% was wrong both v1 and v2; intuition about cosmetic-commit ratio in Python codebases doesn't match reality. Methodology pattern 9/9: predicted-band lock forced honest surfacing of the wrong-prediction even when result direction is favorable.
